# Intent: Establish greeting fixture returns Hello rehearsal

## In plain words

Confirm that the existing greeting fixture's greeting() function returns the exact string Hello rehearsal, establishing a known baseline for the lifecycle-pilot domain.

## Problem

The greeting() function in src/greeting.py must return exactly Hello rehearsal to satisfy the lifecycle-pilot domain's greeting contract. Without an explicit intent establishing this expectation, there is no traceable link between the fixture's required behavior and the verification and release process.

## Success measures

| Measure | Today | When reached | Observed |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| greeting() returns exactly Hello rehearsal | not measured | greeting() == "Hello rehearsal" | source inspection of src/greeting.py |

## Not this

- Changing the return value of greeting().
- Adding new functions or modules beyond the existing fixture.
- Performance or load-testing of greeting().

limits: These observations require content review of the actual final document and native reports. Draft admission is not a writing-quality verdict or full native qualification.
judgement_findings: The native Markdown report says no failures and its JSON has empty failures/denied_calls, contradicting four observed results (87, 90, 136, 185).

The final success measure is an assertion with source inspection as its observation. The decoded template says operational measures are observed after delivery and excludes code/verification review as the measure.
The claimed absence of a traceable link is not supported by a content read of the imported governing records. The requested one-intent task does not establish that absence.
ARTIFACTS.md and the harness-orient read route were not read. The task already selected intent and no links were added; these are discovery observations, not newly invented gates.
Seven empty searches, one guessed missing path and a large inventory read remain costly. The tool index was read, but its input-relative naming and exact-basename rule were not consistently used.
The metadata identity operation worked; no wheel-base64 dump occurred. All six copied component/fixture/document identity values checked here match.
This single run used fewer calls and less elapsed time than Opus09 but more peak input context. It does not establish general efficiency or context reduction.
conclusion: Partial diagnostic. Exact draft preparation and metadata identity checking work; content review and failure reporting remain deficient. Full native qualification is incomplete.
